# Brotli data (RFC 7932)

`formal/lean4/L4Factoidal/Codec/BrotliData.lean` holds data of RFC 7932 that a Brotli decoder
needs and cannot compute. It is generated by `tools/brotli/gen-brotli-data.py` from
google/brotli at tag v1.1.0 (https://github.com/google/brotli, MIT licence, `LICENSE` here):

| Data | Source file | Spec |
|---|---|---|
| Static dictionary, 122,784 bytes, SHA-256 `20e42eb1b511c21806d4d227d07e5dd06877d8ce7b3a817f378f313653f35c70` | `c/common/dictionary.bin` | RFC 7932 Appendix A |
| 121 word transforms (type, prefix, suffix) | `c/common/transform.c` | RFC 7932 Appendix B |
| Context lookup table, 2,048 bytes | `c/common/context.c` | RFC 7932 section 7.1 |

The generator checks the dictionary's size and SHA-256 before it writes anything. The
transforms and the context table are read by compiling `tools/brotli/dump-tables.c` against
the two source files, so the Lean data is the library's own tables, not a transcription.

No Brotli source code is copied into this repository. The decoder
(`formal/lean4/L4Factoidal/Codec/Brotli.lean`) is written in Lean from RFC 7932.

Regenerate:

    git clone --depth 1 --branch v1.1.0 https://github.com/google/brotli /tmp/brotli
    python3 tools/brotli/gen-brotli-data.py /tmp/brotli formal/lean4/L4Factoidal/Codec/BrotliData.lean
